risks.risk: Exact model/year/engine displacement is not confirmed (seller says “ZZR”, but photos don’t clearly show “ZZR” or a model plate). Wrong model means wrong market pricing.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the bike’s model/variant plate or the VIN/engine number area, plus a photo of the full tank badge showing “ZZR” (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Kawasaki sport bike with unknown displacement, worst-case for value among similar bikes.

risks.risk: “Working fine” may be false (could have electrical, starting, overheating, or transmission issues not visible).
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start + idle, and a quick clip showing all lights/gauges working (headlight, indicators, brake light).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Accident damage or frame/fork issues may exist but aren’t shown (only cockpit/tank/front wheel are visible).
risks.proof: Photos of both sides of the bike, front fork alignment, frame/engine mounts, and close-ups of any cracks/welds; plus a straight-on front shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible cosmetic/structural wear typical of used bikes, without assuming it’s accident-free.

risks.risk: Tire/brake wear and service condition are unknown (front disc is visible but pad thickness/rotor condition and tire tread depth aren’t).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of brake pads/rotor wear and tire tread depth on both front and rear.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tires/brakes may need service soon.

proof_requests: Clear photo showing the full “ZZR” model badge (or model plate) and engine/VIN number area.
Video of cold start and a brief ride or at least revs showing stable RPM (plus indicators/headlight/brake light check).
Full side photos (left and right) and a straight-on front shot to check fork/frame alignment.
Close-ups of tires (tread depth) and brake pads/rotor condition (front and rear).
response.reason: The photos suggest a Kawasaki, but the specific “ZZR” model and working condition are not verifiable from the provided images. Without model confirmation and proof it runs, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
